verdict.rationale: Highnote is an API-first payments platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation policy. The pack only covers the GraphQL API, a beta Node.js SDK and webhooks, none of which address versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
